probe_source:
extends SceneTree

# Disposable production-client audit. Synthetic death/removal fixture is explicit;
# training fixture comes from ordinary simulation reserve/confirm commands.
const Battle = preload("res://scripts/simulation/battle.gd")
const Field = preload("res://scripts/client/battlefield.gd")
var records: Array[Dictionary] = []

func _initialize() -> void:
	_run.call_deferred()

func _run() -> void:
	root.size = Vector2i(640, 820)
	var battle = Battle.new()
	battle.initialize(7)
	battle.set_connected("Builder", true)
	battle.set_connected("General", true)
	battle.command("Builder", {"action": "ready", "value": true})
	battle.command("General", {"action": "ready", "value": true})
	battle.command("General", {"action": "reserve", "kind": "footmen", "building": "ally_barracks"})
	battle.command("General", {"action": "confirm"})
	var wire: Dictionary = JSON.parse_string(JSON.stringify(battle.snapshot()))
	var training_id: String = ""
	var live_id: String = ""
	for unit in wire.units:
		if unit.team == "ally":
			if unit.train_ticks > 0: training_id = str(unit.id)
			else: live_id = str(unit.id)
	var field = Field.new()
	root.add_child(field)
	field.network.role = "General"
	field.network.joined = true
	field.update_snapshot(wire)
	for _frame in range(4): await process_frame
	var training_point: Vector2 = field.camera.unproject_position(field.visuals[training_id].node.position + Vector3(0, 0.9, 0))
	field.select_at(training_point, false)
	_record("known_training_click_not_selectable", not training_id in field.selection, field.selection.duplicate())
	var server_result: Dictionary = battle.command("General", {"action": "order", "units": field.selection.duplicate(), "mode": "stop", "x": 0, "z": 0})
	records.append({"case": "server_rejects_client_training_selection", "result": server_result})
	field.drag_start = training_point - Vector2(8, 8)
	field.end_drag(training_point + Vector2(8, 8), false)
	_record("known_training_drag_not_selectable", not training_id in field.selection, field.selection.duplicate())
	# Received death fixture retains the pre-existing production visual for its
	# animation. The bug is reselecting it after first-time death cleanup.
	for unit in wire.units:
		if str(unit.id) == live_id: unit.hp = 0
	field.update_snapshot(wire)
	var dead_point: Vector2 = field.camera.unproject_position(field.visuals[live_id].node.position + Vector3(0, 0.9, 0))
	field.select_at(dead_point, false)
	_record("known_dead_click_not_selectable", not live_id in field.selection, field.selection.duplicate())
	field.update_snapshot(wire)
	_record("next_dead_snapshot_prunes_reselection", not live_id in field.selection, field.selection.duplicate())
	field.drag_start = dead_point - Vector2(8, 8)
	field.end_drag(dead_point + Vector2(8, 8), false)
	_record("known_dead_drag_not_selectable", not live_id in field.selection, field.selection.duplicate())
	field.groups[0] = [live_id, "missing_battalion"]
	var recall = InputEventKey.new()
	recall.keycode = KEY_1
	recall.pressed = true
	field._unhandled_input(recall)
	_record("group_recall_filters_dead_and_missing", field.selection.is_empty(), field.selection.duplicate())
	print(JSON.stringify({"scope": "Production client called locally; not browser interaction or network race proof", "records": records}))
	field.queue_free()
	quit(0)

func _record(label: String, passed: bool, selected: Array) -> void:
	records.append({"case": label, "passes_desired_behavior": passed, "selected": selected})
